# Per-tick source outcomes for the pg-router-source-persistent-failure replay
# (bead pg2-tv11a; see ../source_persistent_failure_test.go).
#
# Extracted 2026-10-05 from the pg-router daemon's stderr log
# (~/.local/state/pg-router/launchd-stderr.log, history from 2026-09-17), the
# only record of per-tick source outcomes: Prometheus history is too short and
# pg_router_source_failures_total resets on every restart. Only source names,
# periods and timestamps are kept -- no error text, paths or identifiers.
#
# What the log holds, and the inference applied:
#   * It records ONE line per FAILED source tick ("producer tick: source failed")
#     and nothing for a successful tick. Successful ticks are therefore INFERRED.
#   * Process starts are the "loaded pg-router config" lines (restarts closer
#     than 60s are one start). Each segment below is one process run (kind
#     "restart"), or a clip of a long run that begins on a success (kind
#     "window"); the replay model starts a segment's gauge at its start, exactly
#     as the daemon initialises last-success to process start.
#   * A source fires no sooner than its period apart, so two consecutive failure
#     lines closer than max(2 x period, 60s) have NO success tick between them
#     (one unbroken failure run). A larger gap means the source ticked and
#     succeeded in between: successes are placed every period from the previous
#     failure (or the segment start) up to one period before the next failure.
#     That rule is conservative for the "must not fire" cases (it makes failure
#     runs longer, never shorter).
#   * Source periods are the daemon's configured intervals at extraction:
#     10s for the three queue sources, 60s for pr-team/pr-mine, 30m for
#     thread-me.
#
# Format. "segment <scenario> <source> <period_seconds> <start> <end> <kind>"
# opens a segment (times are UTC, end is exclusive); the lines below it, up to
# the next "segment", are tick outcomes with offsets in seconds from the
# segment start:
#   S <from> <to>     successful ticks at from, from+period, ... <= to
#   F <o1> <o2> ...   failed ticks at exactly those offsets
